title: Detection of the rotator cuff tears using a novel convolutional neural network from magnetic resonance image (MRI)
summary: Full article evaluates a CNN on MRI for rotator-cuff tear detection, comparing 2D and 3D imaging and clinician interpretations. The specific tear-detection result is evaluated on patient MRI data; conclusions limited to that dataset and reader comparison.
